notes.title: Our Hero! Last: Free Demo available now!
notes.content:
The time is coming!
After one more year of development the 3rd and final game of the Our Hero! trilogy will also be released.
The official release date is:

[b]14th October 2022[/b]

If you haven't done yet, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076920/Our_Hero_Last/]wishlist Our Hero! Last[/url] to be notified on the release date and take advantage of the launch offer 😉

Watch the teaser trailer:
[previewyoutube=fNHW8vLso-M;full][/previewyoutube]

A playable free demo is available from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076920/Our_Hero_Last/]Steam store page[/url]: try it out and leave your precious feedback. I created a specific topic to let you leave all your critiques and suggestion there!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2076920/discussions/0/5179725348523451771/]-> Join the discussion <-[/url]

Finally, I'm here to inform you that Our Hero! Last will take part at the Steam Next Fest, from the 3rd to 10th of October! Stay tuned to enjoy this next big event! 🤩

I hope you enjoy the demo and to hear from you soon :3
Bye! ✌️

notes.title: New Setting: Full-screen/Window mode now available!
notes.content:
Our Hero! First and Our Hero! Two both always forced full-screen at start, but many people asked for the possibility to play the game not in full-screen, so I finally came up with a solution and introduced this easy configuration.
At the start of the game a simple box will let you choose if start playing the game [b]full-screen or in window mode.[/b]
It's a very basic solution for now, but better than nothing 🙂
This setting is available from:
[b]- Version 1.2.0 in Our Hero! First
- Version 1.1.0 in Our Hero! Two[/b]
[b]One more tip: you can always [/b] press [u]ALT + ENTER[/u] any time to toggle full-screen mode 😉
This setting has been fine-tuned during the development of the third and last chapter of the saga, Our Hero! Last, so it will be available at game launch there.
If you didn't already do so, add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076920/Our_Hero_Last/]Our Hero! Last[/url] to your wish list!
Follow [url=https://twitter.com/stesproject]stesproject on Twitter[/url] to stay up to date with the development!
The release of the last chapter is planned for October 2022 🙂

Thank you for playing.
See you soon! ❣️

notes.title: Announcing release date: 29 October 2021!
notes.content:
Finally, here we go!
One year has passed since the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/847560/Our_Hero_First/]Our Hero! First[/url], the first of a series of three games, planned to be developed and released in a three-year period.
Our Hero! Two is coming too, the [b]29th October 2021[/b]!

This second chapter improved a lot compared to its prequel. In Our Hero! Two you'll find:
- better graphics and animations
- a nicer game menu and title screen
- improved battle system
- two more heroes in your team, giving you a more variegated gameplay
- a lot of mini games
- upgradable weapons
- 9 new acts and brand new places to explore

It's been a long journey, but I hope you could appreciate this new adventure and the hard work behind this title as much as I enjoyed developing it.
Said this, stay tuned! I'll be posting more news very soon!

notes.title: Announcing Our Hero! Two, the sequel of Our Hero! First!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the next chapter of the Our Hero! saga: Our Hero! Two!
Our Hero! Two is a Hack'n'Slash adventure game with RPG mechanics starred by cute and colorful characters. The game involves seamlessly alternating platforming sections, free-to-explore environments dotted with secrets to collect and enemies to fight in frantic real-time battles, each guarded by armored and evasive boss which require timing and tactics to hit in an opening.

[h1]Our Hero! Two Story[/h1]
Our Beloved King Has died.
A hitherto unknown party has laid his claim to the throne, but his intentions are all but benign.
He plans to siphon the special powers of every weapon in the world and collect them all into a single sword: his own!
If nobody can stop him, his plan could plunge the heroes’ world into ruin, and he seems to even have ulterior motives than those…
Fortunately, before the King perished he managed to gather two more heroes, who will be accompanying and assisting Ourhero in his quest!
Prepare yourself, for the world of heroes needs you!
